comment: cmd.c cmd_from_func() witness for its last-resort <space> arm (3062-3064). The rc file binds <space> to the run prefix and rebinds G, run's only key, to #wait. getpos() asks cmd_from_func(do_run) for every key it reads (getpos.c:898), and with no other key bound to run the answer is ' '. Farlook picks the hero with '.', then a second farlook reads <space> as the run prefix, so the following 'l' moves the cursor in getpos()'s rush-and-run steps before '.' picks that spot. G then waits a turn.
